title: Values Adventure
welcome_lead: What does a society believe? Meet values. 💎

final_note: You learned what values are and how they guide behaviour.

walkthroughs.body_html:
A value is a belief about right and wrong.

Values guide our choices — even when nobody is watching.

UK schools teach 'fundamental British values':

  • Democracy.
  • Rule of law.
  • Individual liberty.
  • Mutual respect and tolerance.

You also have personal values:

  • Honesty — telling the truth.
  • Fairness — equal chances.
  • Loyalty — sticking by your people.

Knowing your values helps you make tough decisions. 🧭
